body: Layout regression: `.small-action` is now a flex container, but `.small-action-desc` has no `flex: 1` / `flex-grow`, so it shrinks to the width of its content instead of filling the row. The edit/delete `button { float: right }` inside it used to sit at the right edge of the 755px row. Now it sits right next to the description text. Add `flex: 1 1 auto` (plus the prefixed forms) to `.small-action-desc`.

The left padding changed from `4em` to `1.5%`, but `mobile/topic-post.scss` still has `.small-action .small-action-desc .custom-message { margin-left: -40px; }`, and that value was sized to cancel the old 4em indent. With only 1.5% padding left, the negative margin pushes custom messages past the left edge and over or under the avatar icon on mobile. Update or remove that mobile override.

`-ms-align-items` is not a real property; IE10 only understands `-ms-flex-align`, so this line is dead output. Also, this mixin passes `$alignment` straight into `-webkit-box-align` and `-ms-flex-align`, which only accept `start`/`end`/`center`/`baseline`/`stretch`. Any future `@include align-items(flex-start)` or `(flex-end)` will produce invalid declarations for those prefixes. Map the values (flex-start→start, flex-end→end) or document that only center/baseline/stretch are supported.

`order()` passes the same value to `-webkit-box-ordinal-group` / `-moz-box-ordinal-group`. The old box spec is 1-based and defaults to 1, while the modern `order` defaults to 0 and allows 0 and negative values. `@include order(0)` or `order(-1)` produces invalid or different ordering in legacy engines. The legacy value should be `$val + 1`.

`margin-left: auto` is what pushes `.panel` to the right now that `float: right` is gone. The flexbox mixin also emits `display: -webkit-box` / `-moz-box`, but auto margins do not take up free space in the legacy box model. In the browsers those prefixes target, the panel will not be right-aligned and the header icons collapse next to the logo or title. Either drop the legacy box display values (so those browsers fall back to something sane) or keep a float fallback.

`.contents` in header.hbs also has the `clearfix` class, whose `:before` and `:after` pseudo-elements (`display: table; content: " "`) now become flex items. `:after` has the default order 0, so it lands between the logo and the reordered `.extra-info-wrapper` / `.panel`, and it takes part in alignment and spacing. Remove `clearfix` from this element (floats no longer need clearing) or hide the pseudo-elements when flex is used.

This sets `line-height: 1.5` on every `.extra-info-wrapper`, which overrides the carefully tuned `h1` line-heights in desktop/topic-post.scss (`1.3em` / `1.1em` for `.two-rows`) through inheritance for all the other children. The PR also drops the bullet-badge `margin-top: 5px`. Together these change the docked header's vertical metrics. Please check the two-row (category) header, which has a fixed height, for clipping.
